column1: # v131072 is the update's content version (the dump's folder name); neither the base nor the update has a control.nacp, so neither display version is known
# The base game (SDK 22.2.5), never packed: the tables and notes are the update's
# None of this is measured: the game has never run. nninitStartup (main+0x260bb10 in v131072, +0x25bbbf0 in the base) sets the heap to align_down(total - used, 2 MB) - 0xaf200000
# (0xb0a00000 in the base) from QueryMemoryInfo, then hands all of it to AllocateMemoryBlock; the 2.74 GB it keeps back is memory beside the heap (where it goes is not traced:
# with virtual address memory on, as Mario Kart World's, regions mapped in the alias region are the likely user).
# Pool: the Switch 2's 9 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's and Mario Kart World's figure; nothing in this game's files gives the pool). With the host's used memory (64 MB) the heap
# request is 0x240000000 - 0x4000000 - 0xaf200000 = 0x18ce00000 (6.20 GB), and the 2.74 GB stay for the alias region.
# Layout: 256 MB in front + 5 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 7.5 GB heap region (1.3 GB above the request, address space only).
# The alias region: the NPDM declares 48 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on, and this SDK's AddressRegionManager (constructor sdk+0x16ba30 in both builds)
# keeps its 1 GB node area (0x3fe00000) at the start of the alias region; 1 GB + the 2.74 GB the heap leaves + 1.26 GB for fragmentation. Its AllocateAddressRegion aligns
# regions to 64 KB or 2 MB only, so no SDK cut (the note, Memory). Whether the allocator fits is open until the first run (DM_REGIONS, the [mem] lines)
# The update's NPDM (META +0x14): 48 MB (the base's: 24 MB)
# Shader/ (the bfsha packs), Effect/ (particle esetb), UI/ (layout archives), Layout2Shader/ (the layout shader pack MergeShader), Lib/ (agl, gsys and terrain resource packs: BAHS)
